subject: reasoning
question: If A × B means that A is the brother of B, A – B means that A is the sister of B, A + B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the paternal aunt of R?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png] 

Given :

 
 

 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
–

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Father

 
 
 

 
 
to B

 
 
 

So,

 
• Option - (1) : P – Q × R → P is the sister of Q who is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc27c9d139cf4f16eaadd2d2739de1caed4bdd37b90ad476b4a330d4500dfced.png] ​

Here, P is the sister of R.

 
• Option - (2) : P – Q + R → P is the sister of Q who is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c3a5b2942f39a9977f5e3859eb250611b40c830a4f5af6a0e8a79e78509c26b.png] ​

Here, **P is paternal aunt of R.**

 
• Option - (3) : P × Q + R → P is the brother of Q who is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/699b40461125ec7ca26a751c26541f7e0fbd401500ff5c8925c50f3eaae75c91.png] ​

Here, P is the paternal uncle of R.

 
• Option - (4) : P + Q – R → P is the father of Q who is the sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48f3762efc599280ce8f3a508e77b13a5fc2f366c6affda1756eced61caa1477.png] ​

Here, P is the father of R.

Thus, only option - (2), 'P – Q + R' shows that P is the paternal aunt of R.

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
